evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: The collective 'We ratified' enacts communal-sharing — a shared-body decision, not a hierarchical command or proportional exchange.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: Framing the design in terms of cost avoidance (lost work) and consequence-for-choice (client drops) is proportionality reasoning — market-pricing.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Presenting two reciprocal, interchangeable paths to the same outcome (poll or piggyback) enacts even exchange — equality-matching.
